_comment: The Zomi names that replace English personal names in training pairs (docs/ZOMI_NAMES.md). Only names the project owner gave belong here; never add one that a Zomi speaker did not supply. A name counts as confirmed only when a second person has checked it.
applies_to: training data first (owner's decision of 2026-11-08); translation time later
owner_words: for young adult girls and boys name Cing Khup and Ngam Bawm, and also Cingno for girls and Thangno for boys, for married men Pa Pa Thang and women Nu Cing, for older men Pu Ngam Bawm and women Pi Cing Khup, etc
to_confirm: The owner listed 'Cing Khup and Ngam Bawm' for young adult girls and boys. Read in that order: Cing Khup for girls, Ngam Bawm for boys.
Cingno (girls) and Thangno (boys) can be used from toddler to adult (owner, 2026-11-13). They are stored under the stage key 'child', which is now only a label for that range.

Address forms (owner, 2026-11-13), recorded in address_forms and NOT applied by the tool yet: an unmarried person from age 12 until marriage is called 'Lia' (girls) or 'Taang' (boys; short form 'Tg.') before the name; after marriage 'Nu' (women) and 'Pa' (men); from age 60 'Pi' (women) and 'Pu' (men). Open: how these combine with the young adult names Cing Khup and Ngam Bawm (does 'Lia' stand before 'Cing Khup', or replace it?).
The owner ended with 'etc': more names are to come. Until then each group has one name, so a full run is refused (a run needs 10 per gender).
owner_words_2026_11_13: the correct form is Pa Thang, and the age for Cingno and Thangno can be toddle to adult, but if they are not married we call it name before Lia for girls, Taang or Tg for Boys, age 12 to until they married, and after they married, Nu and Pa, after 60, Pu and Pi

address_forms.status: recorded in the owner's words; not applied by localize_names.py; wording to be confirmed

owner_words_2026_11_13_b: the Lia and Tg are always come before the name
owner_words_2026_11_13_c: Tg. is the shortform of Taang
